entries.176f05eff9cc2c17: It sets out as its corporate philosophy "We continue to polish people, work, and the company, and contribute to society through the construction business," and has formulated its medium-term management plan (2025-2027), with fiscal 2025 (the fiscal year ended March 2026) as its first year. Its basic management policy is "management suited to its size, qualitative growth," and toward the 450th anniversary of its founding it sets out thoroughly practicing management suited to its size and achieving qualitative growth rather than "expansion of scale," and working to strengthen its business base through its own efforts without leaving itself to change. As issues to be addressed with priority, it lists rebuilding its core system, strengthening its response to overtime work regulations, shifting to selective order-taking, developing next-generation management ranks, improving payment terms for construction contract amounts, responding to disclosure requests for greenhouse gas-related information, and responding to natural disaster risks. The numerical targets of the medium-term management plan are not written in the main text.
